literature.headline_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒研究进展综述。
literature.lead_zh: 本综述聚焦基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)的流行学、气候驱动、诊断技术与抗病毒靶点四大关键发现。
key_findings_zh: 全球CHIKV阳性率约14%,但研究间异质性极高,提示需谨慎解读各地区数据[10.1515/reveh-2026-0070]。
气候变暖推动CHIKV向更高纬度蔓延,低收入地区缺乏基础设施,适应策略不均衡[10.1186/s40249-026-01480-3]。
双模态LFA可同时检测CHIKV抗原与IL‐6,灵敏度达98.2%,为现场快速诊断提供新方案[10.1021/acsami.6c10007]。
脂肪酸合酶(FASN)介导的蛋白棕榈酰化是MAYV复制必需步骤,提示FASN为潜在抗病毒靶点[10.64898/2026.07.24.740668]。
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 异质性高、气候驱动扩散、诊断技术进步与新抗病毒靶点出现,均提示CHIKV及相关病毒的公共卫生风险持续演变。
literature.caveats_zh: 流行学数据受样本分布不均、诊断方法差异影响;气候模型基于现有数据,未来变化仍不确定;LFA验证样本有限;MAYV研究仅体外,需动物/临床验证。
literature.headline_en: Key Advances in Chikungunya Virus Research.
literature.lead_en: This brief highlights four pivotal findings on CHIKV epidemiology, climate-driven spread, diagnostic innovation, and a novel antiviral target.
key_findings_en: The global pooled CHIKV positivity rate is ~14% but exhibits extreme heterogeneity (I2>97%), underscoring caution in interpreting country‐level estimates [10.1515/reveh-2026-0070].

Climate change is accelerating CHIKV circulation into higher latitudes, yet low‐income regions lack foundational resilience, revealing a socioeconomic‐climatic gap in adaptation strategies [10.1186/s40249-026-01480-3].
A dual‐mode lateral flow assay simultaneously detects CHIKV antigen and IL‐6 with 98.2% sensitivity, offering a promising point‐of‐care diagnostic platform [10.1021/acsami.6c10007].

Host fatty‐acid synthase (FASN)‐dependent palmitoylation of viral nsP1 is essential for Mayaro virus replication, positioning FASN as a potential broad‐spectrum antiviral target [10.64898/2026.07.24.740668].
literature.trend_or_risk_en: High heterogeneity, climate‐driven expansion, diagnostic breakthroughs, and emerging antiviral targets collectively signal evolving public health risks for CHIKV and related arboviruses.
literature.caveats_en: Epidemiological estimates are limited by uneven sampling and diagnostic variability; climate projections rely on current data and may shift; the LFA validation cohort is modest; the MAYV study is in vitro and requires in vivo confirmation.
literature.brief_en: The compiled evidence underscores that CHIKV remains a globally heterogeneous threat, increasingly influenced by climate change, while advances in rapid diagnostics and novel antiviral targets offer promising avenues for control and treatment.

literature.zh: 本综述聚焦基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)的流行学、气候驱动、诊断技术与抗病毒靶点四大关键发现。；全球CHIKV阳性率约14%,但研究间异质性极高,提示需谨慎解读各地区数据[10.1515/reveh-2026-0070]。；气候变暖推动CHIKV向更高纬度蔓延,低收入地区缺乏基础设施,适应策略不均衡[10.1186/s40249-026-01480-3]。；双模态LFA可同时检测CHIKV抗原与IL‐6,灵敏度达98.2%,为现场快速诊断提供新方案[10.1021/acsami.6c10007]。；脂肪酸合酶(FASN)介导的蛋白棕榈酰化是MAYV复制必需步骤,提示FASN为潜在抗病毒靶点[10.64898/2026.07.24.740668]。
literature.en: This brief highlights four pivotal findings on CHIKV epidemiology, climate-driven spread, diagnostic innovation, and a novel antiviral target. The global pooled CHIKV positivity rate is ~14% but exhibits extreme heterogeneity (I2>97%), underscoring caution in interpreting country‐level estimates [10.1515/reveh-2026-0070]. Climate change is accelerating CHIKV circulation into higher latitudes, yet low‐income regions lack foundational resilience, revealing a socioeconomic‐climatic gap in adaptation strategies [10.1186/s40249-026-01480-3]. A dual‐mode lateral flow assay simultaneously detects CHIKV antigen and IL‐6 with 98.2% sensitivity, offering a promising point‐of‐care diagnostic platform [10.1021/acsami.6c10007]. papers.title: Global molecular and serological evidence of dengue and chikungunya infection: a systematic review and meta-analysis of 158,608 tested participants.
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Dengue virus (DENV) and chikungunya virus (CHIKV) are Aedes-borne arboviruses with overlapping clinical manifestations, shared vectors, and substantial diagnostic challenges in co-endemic settings. This systematic review and meta-analysis synthesized published evidence on molecular detection, serological positivity, and DENV–CHIKV dual positivity/co-infection in human clinical, surveillance, and community-based study populations. Content Following PRISMA 2020 guidance, five bibliographic databases (PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, ScienceDirect, and Google Scholar) and supplementary grey-literature/preprint sources were searched for English-language studies published from 1 January 1980 to 31 December 2024. No prospective PROSPERO or OSF protocol registration was available. Eligible records reported extractable numerators and denominators for DENV and/or CHIKV in humans using recognized molecular or serological assays. A total of 196 studies comprising 158,608 tested or suspected participants were included in the extraction table. The pooled CHIKV estimate was 14.0 % (95 % CI: 12.0–16.4; I 2 =97.5 %), with molecular and serological estimates of 9.8 and 15.7 %, respectively. The pooled DENV estimate was 13.8 % (95 % CI: 10.9–17.3; I 2 =99.0 %), with molecular and serological estimates of 13.1 % (95 % CI: 7.9–21.0) and 14.3 % (95 % CI: 10.2–19.8), respectively. DENV–CHIKV dual positivity/co-infection was 52.9 % (95 % CI: 48.7–57.1) among studies that tested and reported both outcomes. Country-level estimates varied widely and should be interpreted as summaries of available studies rather than nationally representative burden estimates. Funnel-plot asymmetry was statistically significant in DENV analyses but not in the overall CHIKV analysis. Summary Available evidence indicates extensive but highly heterogeneous DENV and CHIKV positivity across selected clinical and surveillance populations. The pooled estimates should be interpreted cautiously because of substantial between-study heterogeneity, diagnostic variability, outbreak-period sampling, and uneven geographic representation. Outlook The findings support integrated arboviral surveillance, multiplex diagnostics, and vector-control preparedness in co-endemic regions.

Content Following PRISMA 2020 guidance, five bibliographic databases (PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, ScienceDirect, and Google Scholar) and supplementary grey-literature/preprint sources were searched for English-language studies published from 1 January 1980 to 31 December 2024. No prospective PROSPERO or OSF protocol registration was available. Eligible records reported extractable numerators and denominators for DENV and/or CHIKV in humans using recognized molecular or serological assays. A total of 196 studies comprising 158,608 tested or suspected participants were included in the extraction table. The pooled CHIKV estimate was 14.0 % (95 % CI: 12.0–16.4; I 2 =97.5 %), with molecular and serological estimates of 9.8 and 15.7 %, respectively. The pooled DENV estimate was 13.8 % (95 % CI: 10.9–17.3; I 2 =99.0 %), with molecular and serological estimates of 13.1 % (95 % CI: 7.9–21.0) and 14.3 % (95 % CI: 10.2–19.8), respectively. DENV–CHIKV dual positivity/co-infection was 52.9 % (95 % CI: 48.7–57.1) among studies that tested and reported both outcomes. Country-level estimates varied widely and should be interpreted as summaries of available studies rather than nationally representative burden estimates. Funnel-plot asymmetry was statistically significant in DENV analyses but not in the overall CHIKV analysis. Summary Available evidence indicates extensive but highly heterogeneous DENV and CHIKV positivity across selected clinical and surveillance populations. The pooled estimates should be interpreted cautiously because of substantial between-study heterogeneity, diagnostic variability, outbreak-period sampling, and uneven geographic representation. Outlook The findings support integrated arboviral surveillance, multiplex diagnostics, and vector-control preparedness in co-endemic regions.

The central question involves synthesizing molecular and serological evidence of CHIKV infection, including dual positivity with DENV.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A systematic review and meta-analysis following PRISMA 2020 guidance, searching five bibliographic databases and grey-literature sources from 1980 to 2024. Eligible studies reported extractable numerators and denominators for CHIKV/DENV using molecular or serological assays, with 196 studies (158,608 participants) included.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Pooled CHIKV positivity was 14.0% (95% CI: 12.0–16.4; I2=97.5%), with molecular (9.8%) and serological (15.7%) estimates. analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis synthesizes molecular and serological evidence of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection across 158,608 participants from 196 studies. Pooled CHIKV positivity was 14.0%, with dual DENV–CHIKV infection at 52.9% in co-tested populations. Estimates show high heterogeneity (I2=97.5–99.0%) and geographic variability, reflecting diagnostic differences and sampling biases. The findings underscore the need for integrated surveillance and diagnostics in co-endemic regions, though results should be interpreted cautiously due to methodological limitations.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点关注 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 和登革热病毒 (DENV) 作为伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒,它们具有重叠的临床表现、共同的 媒介 以及共流行环境中的诊断挑战。核心问题涉及综合 CHIKV 感染的分子和血清学证据,包括 DENV 双重阳性。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 根据 PRISMA 2020 指南进行的系统回顾和荟萃分析,检索了 1980 年至 2024 年的五个书目数据库和灰色文献来源。符合条件的研究报告了使用分子或血清学检测可提取的 CHIKV/DENV 分子和分母,其中包括 196 项研究(158,608 名参与者)。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 汇总的 CHIKV 阳性率为 14.0%(95% CI:12.0–16.4;I2=97.5%),分子学(9.8%)和血清学(15.7%)估计值。在报告两者的研究中,DENV-CHIKV 双重阳性率为 52.9%(95% CI:48.7-57.1%)。估计值差异很大,并且不具有全国代表性。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 研究间的显着异质性 (I2=97.5–99.0%)、诊断变异性、暴发 周期抽样和不均匀的地理代表性限制了普遍性。漏斗图不对称对于 DENV 很显着,但对于整体 CHIKV 则不显着。没有可用的前瞻性协议注册。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果支持在共同流行地区进行综合虫媒病毒 监测、多重诊断和 媒介 控制准备。由于异质性和代表性问题,应谨慎解释国家层面的估计值。

papers.title: Impact of climate change on the global circulation of chikungunya virus: current evidence, future projections, and adaptation strategies.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Climate change is accelerating the circulation of the chikungunya virus (CHIKV), posing a significant threat to both endemic areas and immunologically naive temperate regions. This study aims to synthesize empirical climatic drivers, future transmission projections, and global adaptation strategies to evaluate current evidence and identify key research gaps. Methods This scoping review completed protocol registration on the Open Science Framework prior to literature retrieval, with systematic searches conducted across PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus and EBSCOhost to collect all relevant English peer-reviewed papers published between Jan 1, 2000 and Nov 1, 2025. Multi-level screening filtered out unqualified literature, and unified datasets related to epidemiological parameters, predictive models and adaptation measures were extracted from 104 eligible studies. Results The results indicate that: (1) Current evidence reveals post-2014 research favors Europe and South America, disproportionately focusing on temperature ( n = 38) and precipitation ( n = 32). CHIKV transmission exhibits a non-linear thermal optimum (23–30 °C) and a 1-to-4-week lag following extreme precipitation. (2) Future projections ( n = 24) consistently indicate transboundary vector expansion into higher latitudes and altitudes. (3) Regarding adaptation strategies, we conceptualized a three-tiered intervention framework. However, a stark socioeconomic-climatic gap emerged: while 43% of the research centers on mid-tier early warning systems in high and upper-middle-income nations, evidence for the foundational infrastructural resilience in low-income regions is limited. Conclusion This global climate-CHIKV synthesis reveals structurally imbalanced preparedness. To mitigate escalating transboundary risks, international health policies must pivot from solely reactive surveillance. Future priorities should include proactive, climate-resilient urban infrastructure and equitable cross-border coalitions in neglected low-resource settings.

papers.title: Urban heat island intensity and chikungunya incidence: a multi-city time-series analysis in Brazil.
papers.abstract: Abstract Objectives Urban heat islands (UHIs) produce 2°C–8°C in urban cores excesses, accelerating Aedes aegypti development and shortening chikungunya virus (CHIKV) extrinsic incubation, yet UHI intensity's (UHII) independent contribution to CHIKV transmission remanins unquantified. Methods We conducted an ecological time-series analysis of five Brazilian cities (2015–24; n = 563 city-months) . Monthly UHII was derived from MODIS land surface temperature (urban-core minus peri-urban) via Google Earth Engine; CHIKV incidence came from InfoDengue. Lag-specific (0-3 months) Poisson generalized linear models were adjusted for temperature, humidity, and seasonality. Given severe overdispersion, quasi-Poisson and negative-binomial models were the preferred sensitivity analyses. Results Across 261 353 cases, each 1°C UHII increase was associated with higher lag-1 incidence in subtropical Rio de Janeiro (RR = 2.857, 95% CI 2.799–2.915) and Salvador (RR = 1.168, 1.156–1.179; both P < .001). Brasília showed inverse associations (lags 0–3), Fortaleza (highest burden, 133 371 cases) a mixed lag pattern, and São Paulo minimal effects despite the highest UHII. Incidence peaked in April–May. Conclusions UHII–CHIKV associations were heterogeneous; city-specific thermal context should inform integrating satellite-derived heat metrics into arboviral surveillance, as several associations attenuated or lost statistical significance under overdispersion-robust models and were sensitive to individual epidemic years.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the independent contribution of urban heat island intensity (UHII) to chikungunya virus (CHIKV) transmission across five Brazilian cities from 2015–2024. Using an ecological time-series analysis with 563 city-months and 261,353 cases, researchers derived monthly UHII from MODIS land surface temperature and CHIKV incidence from InfoDengue. Poisson generalized linear models adjusted for temperature, humidity, and seasonality revealed heterogeneous associations: each 1°C UHII increase significantly increased lag-1 incidence in Rio de Janeiro (RR = 2.857) and Salvador (RR = 1.168), but Brasília showed inverse associations, Fortaleza a mixed pattern, and São Paulo minimal effects. Despite these findings, associations were sensitive to model choice and epidemic years, with some attenuating under overdispersion-robust models. The study emphasizes the need for city-specific thermal context in integrating satellite-derived heat metrics into arboviral surveillance.

papers.title: Manual de atención de pacientes con fiebre Chikungunya
papers.abstract: La fiebre chikungunya es una arbovirosis, causada por el virus chikungunya (CHIKV, siglas en inglés), familia Togaviridae, género Alphavirus. La descripción clínica y el aislamiento viral se realizó en la Meseta de Makonde en Tanganica (actual Tanzania, África) en 1952-1953, presentándose epidemias cíclicas en el continente africano. Los primeros casos de transmisión autóctona en las Américas se presentaron el año 2013, en la isla Saint Martin, extendiéndose rápidamente y causando grandes epidemias en el continente americano y el Caribe (2014-2015). Es transmitida principalmente por la picadura del mosquito Aedes aegypti. Clínicamente se presenta por etapas: aguda, subaguda y crónica, con predominio de manifestaciones articulares (artralgias, artritis y/o sinovitis). Las formas atípicas comprometen en mayor proporción a las personas inmunosuprimidas. Las madres transmiten el virus a su progenie, especialmente cuando la enfermedad ocurre en el período periparto, los recién nacidos presentan enfermedad grave hasta en un 50 % de los casos. El diagnóstico recomendado se realiza mediante pruebas moleculares como la reacción en cadena de la Polimerasa (PCR, por sus siglas en inglés). No existe tratamiento antiviral específico; la prevención es evitar la picadura del vector transmisor y reducir su exposición. Para la elaboración de este manual se realizó la revisión narrativa de la literatura científica, basada en documentos de organismos internacionales (OMS/OPS) y revistas nacionales e internacionales. Se incluyen algoritmos de actuación y material clínico ilustrativo. El objetivo de este trabajo es sintetizar y difundir los aspectos clínicos y epidemiológicos de la fiebre chikungunya para su aplicación en la práctica clínica. Chikungunya fever is an arboviral disease caused by the chikungunya virus (CHIKV), family Togaviridae, genus Alphavirus. Clinical description and viral isolation were first performed on the Makonde Plateau in Tanganyika (present-day Tanzania, Africa) in 1952-1953, leading to cyclical epidemics across the African continent. The first cases of autochthonous transmission in the Americas occurred in 2013 on the island of Saint Martin, spreading rapidly and causing major epidemics in the Americas and the Caribbean (2014-2015). It is primarily transmitted by the bite of the Aedes aegypti mosquito. Clinically, it presents in three stages: acute, subacute, and chronic, with a predominance of joint manifestations (arthralgia, arthritis, and/or synovitis). Atypical forms affect immunocompromised individuals more frequently. Mothers transmit the virus to their offspring, especially when the disease occurs during the peripartum period. Newborns present with severe illness in up to 50 % of cases. The recommended diagnosis is made using molecular tests such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR). There is no specific antiviral treatment; prevention consists of avoiding bites from the transmitting vector and reducing exposure. This manual was developed through a narrative review of the scientific literature, based on documents from international organizations (WHO/PAHO) and national and international journals. Action algorithms and illustrative clinical material are included. The objective of this work is to synthesize and disseminate the clinical and epidemiological aspects of chikungunya fever for application in clinical practice.

analysis.scope_and_question: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), family Togaviridae, genus Alphavirus, causing chikungunya fever and infection in humans, with focus on clinical stages, transmission, and diagnostic approaches. Central question: What are the clinical, epidemiological, and diagnostic characteristics of chikungunya virus infection and its management?
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: Narrative review of scientific literature based on documents from international organizations (WHO/PAHO) and national/international journals. Includes clinical algorithms and illustrative material for clinical practice application.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: CHIKV is an arbovirus transmitted primarily by Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, causing disease with acute, subacute, and chronic stages dominated by joint manifestations such as arthralgia, arthritis, and synovitis. Severe neonatal disease occurs in up to 50% of cases when maternal infection occurs during the peripartum period. Diagnosis is recommended via molecular tests such as PCR.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review does not report comparative data on diagnostic test performance across different CHIKV lineages or populations. No evidence is provided on the effectiveness of vector control measures or the burden of chronic chikungunya arthritis in specific geographic regions.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Priority research areas include evaluating the performance of molecular diagnostics across CHIKV lineages and developing standardized protocols for neonatal and maternal chikungunya management. Clinical practice should emphasize early diagnosis using PCR and implementation of vector control strategies to reduce transmission.

analysis.summary_en: This review synthesizes clinical and epidemiological aspects of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection, an arbovirus transmitted by Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. CHIKV causes disease characterized by acute, subacute, and chronic stages with predominant joint manifestations. Severe neonatal outcomes occur in up to 50% of cases when maternal infection occurs near delivery. Diagnosis is recommended via PCR. The review, based on a narrative synthesis of international and national literature, highlights the need for standardized diagnostic protocols and targeted research on neonatal outcomes and vector control effectiveness.

El objetivo de este trabajo es sintetizar y difundir los aspectos clínicos y epidemiológicos de la fiebre chikungunya para su aplicación en la práctica clínica. Chikungunya fever is an arboviral disease caused by the chikungunya virus (CHIKV), family Togaviridae, genus Alphavirus. Clinical description and viral isolation were first performed on the Makonde Plateau in Tanganyika (present-day Tanzania, Africa) in 1952-1953, leading to cyclical epidemics across the African continent. The first cases of autochthonous transmission in the Americas occurred in 2013 on the island of Saint Martin, spreading rapidly and causing major epidemics in the Americas and the Caribbean (2014-2015). It is primarily transmitted by the bite of the Aedes aegypti mosquito. Clinically, it presents in three stages: acute, subacute, and chronic, with a predominance of joint manifestations (arthralgia, arthritis, and/or synovitis). Atypical forms affect immunocompromised individuals more frequently. Mothers transmit the virus to their offspring, especially when the disease occurs during the peripartum period. Newborns present with severe illness in up to 50 % of cases. The recommended diagnosis is made using molecular tests such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR). There is no specific antiviral treatment; prevention consists of avoiding bites from the transmitting vector and reducing exposure. This manual was developed through a narrative review of the scientific literature, based on documents from international organizations (WHO/PAHO) and national and international journals. Action algorithms and illustrative clinical material are included. The objective of this work is to synthesize and disseminate the clinical and epidemiological aspects of chikungunya fever for application in clinical practice.

papers.title: Cocoa by-products extracts suppress viral replication and oxidative stress in chikungunya virus-infected cells.
papers.abstract: CONTEXT: Studies have demonstrated a correlation between oxidative stress and Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) replication, underscoring the potential of these biochemical interactions for developing novel antiviral therapies. Since cocoa (Theobroma cacao L.) by-products have exhibited potent antiviral and antioxidant properties, they may represent a promising source for new therapeutic alternatives. OBJECTIVE: To assess the potential of cocoa pod husk (CPH) and cocoa bean shell (CBS) extracts to inhibit viral replication and oxidative stress in an in vitro model of CHIKV infection. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The viability of Huh-7 cells in the presence of extracts (15.6 to 250 μg/mL), and CHIKV-infected cells treated with the extracts was evaluated using the resazurin reduction assay. Antiviral activity was determined by RT-qPCR and plaque assays, while reduction of oxidative stress in infected cells was measured using the dichloro-dihydro-fluorescein diacetate (DCFH-DA) assay at 12 and 24 hours post-infection (hpi). RESULTS: CPH and CBS extracts exhibited minimal cytotoxicity in Huh-7 cells. Remarkably, both extracts exhibited antiviral and antioxidant properties at concentrations above 62.5 μg/mL mainly at 12 hpi. This was evidenced by a significant reduction in viral RNA copies and infectious virus particles, as well as decreased levels of reactive oxygen species (ROS) in CHIKV-infected cells. DISCUSSION AND CONCLUSION: Cocoa extracts reduce the oxidative stress induced by CHIKV in Huh-7 cells while exhibiting antiviral properties, highlighting their potential to modulate both oxidative stress and viral replication. Further studies are recommended to elucidate the mechanisms by which these extracts work.

elements_zh.methods: 使用刃天青还原测定评估 Huh-7 细胞在提取物 (15.6 至 250 μg/mL) 存在下的活力以及用提取物处理的 CHIKV 感染细胞的活力。通过 RT-qPCR 和噬菌斑测定法测定 抗病毒药物 活性,同时在感染后 12 小时和 24 小时使用 DCFH-DA 测定法测量氧化应激的减少。
elements_zh.main_results: CPH 和 CBS 提取物在 Huh-7 细胞中表现出最小的细胞毒性,并在浓度高于 62.5 μg/mL 时(主要是在 12 hpi 时)表现出 抗病毒药物 和抗氧化特性,这通过 CHIKV 感染细胞中病毒 RNA 拷贝、传染性病毒颗粒和活性氧 (ROS) 的显着减少来证明。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 可可提取物可减少 Huh-7 细胞中 CHIKV 诱导的氧化应激,同时表现出 抗病毒药物 特性,突显其调节氧化应激和病毒复制的潜力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,可可副产品可以开发作为 CHIKV 感染的治疗替代品,可能在减少病毒复制和氧化应激方面提供双重好处。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在体外进行的,限制了对体内条件的推广。建议进一步研究以阐明这些提取物的作用机制。由于受控的实验室设置和需要额外的验证,证据强度中等。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Studies have demonstrated a correlation between oxidative stress and Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) replication, underscoring the potential of these biochemical interactions for developing novel antiviral therapies.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study assessed the potential of cocoa pod husk (CPH) and cocoa bean shell (CBS) extracts to inhibit viral replication and oxidative stress in an in vitro model of CHIKV infection using Huh-7 cells.
analysis_en.methods: The viability of Huh-7 cells in the presence of extracts (15.6 to 250 μg/mL) and CHIKV-infected cells treated with the extracts was evaluated using the resazurin reduction assay. Antiviral activity was determined by RT-qPCR and plaque assays, while reduction of oxidative stress was measured using the DCFH-DA assay at 12 and 24 hours post-infection.
analysis_en.main_results: CPH and CBS extracts exhibited minimal cytotoxicity in Huh-7 cells and demonstrated antiviral and antioxidant properties at concentrations above 62.5 μg/mL, mainly at 12 hpi, evidenced by a significant reduction in viral RNA copies, infectious virus particles, and reactive oxygen species (ROS) in CHIKV-infected cells.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: Cocoa extracts reduce the oxidative stress induced by CHIKV in Huh-7 cells while exhibiting antiviral properties, highlighting their potential to modulate both oxidative stress and viral replication.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that cocoa by-products could be developed as therapeutic alternatives for CHIKV infection, potentially offering dual benefits in reducing viral replication and oxidative stress.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was conducted in vitro, limiting generalizability to in vivo conditions. Further studies are recommended to elucidate the mechanisms by which these extracts work. The evidence strength is moderate due to the controlled laboratory setting and need for additional validation.

papers.title_zh: 可可副产品提取物抑制 基孔肯雅病毒 感染细胞中的病毒复制和氧化应激。
papers.source_body_en: CONTEXT: Studies have demonstrated a correlation between oxidative stress and Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) replication, underscoring the potential of these biochemical interactions for developing novel antiviral therapies. Since cocoa (Theobroma cacao L.) by-products have exhibited potent antiviral and antioxidant properties, they may represent a promising source for new therapeutic alternatives. OBJECTIVE: To assess the potential of cocoa pod husk (CPH) and cocoa bean shell (CBS) extracts to inhibit viral replication and oxidative stress in an in vitro model of CHIKV infection. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The viability of Huh-7 cells in the presence of extracts (15.6 to 250 μg/mL), and CHIKV-infected cells treated with the extracts was evaluated using the resazurin reduction assay. Antiviral activity was determined by RT-qPCR and plaque assays, while reduction of oxidative stress in infected cells was measured using the dichloro-dihydro-fluorescein diacetate (DCFH-DA) assay at 12 and 24 hours post-infection (hpi). RESULTS: CPH and CBS extracts exhibited minimal cytotoxicity in Huh-7 cells. Remarkably, both extracts exhibited antiviral and antioxidant properties at concentrations above 62.5 μg/mL mainly at 12 hpi. This was evidenced by a significant reduction in viral RNA copies and infectious virus particles, as well as decreased levels of reactive oxygen species (ROS) in CHIKV-infected cells. DISCUSSION AND CONCLUSION: Cocoa extracts reduce the oxidative stress induced by CHIKV in Huh-7 cells while exhibiting antiviral properties, highlighting their potential to modulate both oxidative stress and viral replication. Further studies are recommended to elucidate the mechanisms by which these extracts work.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:研究证明氧化应激与 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 复制之间存在相关性,强调了这些生化相互作用对于开发新型 抗病毒药物 疗法的潜力。由于可可 (Theobroma cacao L.) 副产品表现出强大的 抗病毒药物 和抗氧化特性,因此它们可能是新的治疗替代品的有前途的来源。目的:评估可可豆壳 (CPH) 和可可豆壳 (CBS) 提取物在 CHIKV 感染体外模型中抑制病毒复制和氧化应激的潜力。材料和方法:使用刃天青还原测定法评估提取物(15.6 至 250 μg/mL)存在下的 Huh-7 细胞以及用提取物处理的 CHIKV 感染细胞的活力。抗病毒药物 活性通过 RT-qPCR 和噬菌斑测定来确定,而感染细胞中氧化应激的减少则使用感染后 12 小时和 24 小时 (hpi) 的二氯二氢荧光素二乙酸酯 (DCFH-DA) 测定来测量。结果:CPH 和 CBS 提取物在 Huh-7 细胞中表现出最小的细胞毒性。值得注意的是,两种提取物均在 12 hpi 浓度高于 62.5 μg/mL 时表现出 抗病毒药物 和抗氧化特性。CHIKV 感染细胞中病毒 RNA 拷贝和感染性病毒颗粒的显着减少以及活性氧 (ROS) 水平的降低证明了这一点。讨论和结论:可可提取物可减少 Huh-7 细胞中 CHIKV 诱导的氧化应激,同时表现出 抗病毒药物 特性,突显其调节氧化应激和病毒复制的潜力。建议进一步研究以阐明这些提取物的作用机制。

papers.title: Dual-Mode Field-Deployable Platform Based on Self-Assembled Magnetic Probes for Simultaneous Monitoring of Chikungunya Virus and Host Immune Status.
papers.abstract: Real-time dual monitoring of pathogen burden and host immune response enables risk stratification and precision therapy, yet remains technically challenging. Addressing the needs of chikungunya fever outbreak control, here, we developed a flexible, ultrasensitive dual-mode lateral flow immunoassay (LFA) capable of simultaneous detection of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) antigen and the inflammatory cytokine IL-6 across clinical samples. An enhanced colorimetric-fluorescent dual-signal magnetic probe (MAu2QD3) was synthesized via electrostatic self-assembly. By tuning the number of loaded signal layers (Au and CdSe/ZnS particles), the LFA platform achieved controllable adjustment of dual-signal output intensities. In parallel, an artificial intelligence-based dual-mode quantitative model was built to automatically integrate colorimetric and fluorescent readouts, yielding accurate target concentration estimates. In naked-eye mode, the assay exhibited visual limits of detection (LODs) of 50 pg·mL-1 for both CHIKV and IL-6. With portable instrument assistance, the colorimetric sensitivity of MAu2QD3-LFA increased by at least 4-fold, while fluorescent detection further reduced the LODs to 0.28 pg·mL-1 for CHIKV and 0.16 pg·mL-1 for IL-6. Validated using 91 clinical samples, the system achieved a sensitivity of 98.2% and a specificity of 100%, enabling reliable acquisition of both pathogen and host immune information. These results highlight strong potential for early surveillance and precise diagnosis of infectious diseases.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chikungunya fever outbreaks require real-time risk stratification and precision therapy, but simultaneous monitoring of pathogen burden and host immune response remains technically challenging. The study aimed to address this gap by developing a dual-mode platform for concurrent detection of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) and host inflammatory markers.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study developed a flexible dual-mode lateral flow immunoassay (LFA) platform designed for outbreak control of chikungunya fever. The platform was validated using 91 clinical samples to assess its diagnostic performance.
analysis.methods: An enhanced colorimetric-fluorescent dual-signal magnetic probe (MAu2QD3) was synthesized via electrostatic self-assembly, enabling controllable adjustment of dual-signal output intensities. An artificial intelligence-based dual-mode quantitative model was built to automatically integrate colorimetric and fluorescent readouts for accurate target concentration estimates.
analysis.main_results: In naked-eye mode, the assay exhibited visual limits of detection (LODs) of 50 pg·mL-1 for both CHIKV and IL-6. With portable instrument assistance, the colorimetric sensitivity increased by at least 4-fold, while fluorescent detection further reduced the LODs to 0.28 pg·mL-1 for CHIKV and 0.16 pg·mL-1 for IL-6. The system achieved a sensitivity of 98.2% and a specificity of 100% when validated using 91 clinical samples.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these findings as demonstrating strong potential for early surveillance and precise diagnosis of chikungunya fever by enabling simultaneous monitoring of pathogen burden and host immune status. The novelty lies in the dual-mode platform integrating magnetic probes and AI-based quantitative modeling for enhanced detection sensitivity.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The platform could inform early surveillance strategies and precision diagnostics for chikungunya fever, potentially improving outbreak response and patient management through simultaneous pathogen and immune marker detection.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on a relatively small clinical sample size (n=91) and the need for portable instrument assistance to achieve the lowest detection limits. The evidence strength is moderate, as further validation in larger, diverse populations and field settings is required to confirm clinical utility.

analysis.summary_en: This study developed a dual-mode lateral flow immunoassay (LFA) platform for simultaneous detection of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) antigen and the inflammatory cytokine IL-6 in clinical samples. The platform utilizes a self-assembled magnetic probe (MAu2QD3) to enable colorimetric and fluorescent dual-signal output, with sensitivity adjustable via signal layer loading. An AI-based quantitative model integrates readouts for accurate target concentration estimates. In naked-eye mode, the assay achieved visual limits of detection (LODs) of 50 pg·mL-1 for both CHIKV and IL-6, while instrument-assisted detection improved sensitivity, reducing LODs to 0.28 pg·mL-1 for CHIKV and 0.16 pg·mL-1 for IL-6. Validation in 91 clinical samples demonstrated 98.2% sensitivity and 100% specificity. The authors highlight the platform's potential for early surveillance and precise diagnosis of chikungunya fever, though further validation in larger populations is needed.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 基孔肯雅热 暴发 需要实时风险分层和精准治疗,但同时监测病原体负荷和 宿主 免疫应答 在技术上仍然具有挑战性。该研究旨在通过开发同时检测 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 和 宿主 炎症标志物的双模式平台来解决这一差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究开发了一种灵活的双模式侧流免疫分析(LFA)平台,专为暴发控制基孔肯雅热而设计。该平台使用 91 个临床样本进行了验证,以评估其诊断性能。
elements_zh.methods: 通过静电自组装合成了增强型比色荧光双信号磁性探针(MAu2QD3),从而实现了双信号输出强度的可控调节。建立了基于人工智能的双模式定量模型,可自动集成比色和荧光读数,以准确估计目标浓度。
elements_zh.main_results: 在肉眼模式下,该检测对 CHIKV 和 IL-6 的视觉检测限 (LOD) 均为 50 pg·mL-1。在便携式仪器的帮助下,比色灵敏度提高了至少 4 倍,而荧光检测进一步将 CHIKV 的 LOD 降低至 0.28 pg·mL-1,将 IL-6 的 LOD 降低至 0.16 pg·mL-1。使用 91 个临床样本进行验证时,该系统的灵敏度为 98.2%,特异性为 100%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为通过同时监测病原体负荷和 宿主 免疫状态,证明了 监测 的早期 诊断 和 基孔肯雅热 的精确 诊断 的强大潜力。新颖之处在于双模式平台集成了磁性探针和基于人工智能的定量建模,以提高检测灵敏度。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该平台可以为 基孔肯雅热 的早期 监测 策略和精确诊断提供信息,通过同时进行病原体和免疫标记检测,有可能改善 暴发 的反应和患者管理。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其依赖相对较小的临床样本量(n = 91),并且需要便携式仪器辅助才能达到最低检测限。证据强度中等,因为需要在更大、多样化的人群和现场环境中进行进一步验证以确认临床实用性。

papers.source_body_en: Real-time dual monitoring of pathogen burden and host immune response enables risk stratification and precision therapy, yet remains technically challenging. Addressing the needs of chikungunya fever outbreak control, here, we developed a flexible, ultrasensitive dual-mode lateral flow immunoassay (LFA) capable of simultaneous detection of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) antigen and the inflammatory cytokine IL-6 across clinical samples. An enhanced colorimetric-fluorescent dual-signal magnetic probe (MAu2QD3) was synthesized via electrostatic self-assembly. By tuning the number of loaded signal layers (Au and CdSe/ZnS particles), the LFA platform achieved controllable adjustment of dual-signal output intensities. In parallel, an artificial intelligence-based dual-mode quantitative model was built to automatically integrate colorimetric and fluorescent readouts, yielding accurate target concentration estimates. In naked-eye mode, the assay exhibited visual limits of detection (LODs) of 50 pg·mL-1 for both CHIKV and IL-6. With portable instrument assistance, the colorimetric sensitivity of MAu2QD3-LFA increased by at least 4-fold, while fluorescent detection further reduced the LODs to 0.28 pg·mL-1 for CHIKV and 0.16 pg·mL-1 for IL-6. Validated using 91 clinical samples, the system achieved a sensitivity of 98.2% and a specificity of 100%, enabling reliable acquisition of both pathogen and host immune information. These results highlight strong potential for early surveillance and precise diagnosis of infectious diseases.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 基孔肯雅热 暴发 需要实时风险分层和精准治疗,但同时监测病原体负荷和 宿主 免疫应答 在技术上仍然具有挑战性。该研究旨在通过开发同时检测 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 和 宿主 炎症标志物的双模式平台来解决这一差距。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究开发了一种灵活的双模式侧流免疫分析(LFA)平台,专为暴发控制基孔肯雅热而设计。该平台使用 91 个临床样本进行了验证,以评估其诊断性能。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过静电自组装合成了增强型比色荧光双信号磁性探针(MAu2QD3),从而实现了双信号输出强度的可控调节。建立了基于人工智能的双模式定量模型,可自动集成比色和荧光读数,以准确估计目标浓度。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在肉眼模式下,该检测对 CHIKV 和 IL-6 的视觉检测限 (LOD) 均为 50 pg·mL-1。在便携式仪器的帮助下,比色灵敏度提高了至少 4 倍,而荧光检测进一步将 CHIKV 的 LOD 降低至 0.28 pg·mL-1,将 IL-6 的 LOD 降低至 0.16 pg·mL-1。使用 91 个临床样本进行验证时,该系统的灵敏度为 98.2%,特异性为 100%。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为通过同时监测病原体负荷和 宿主 免疫状态,证明了 监测 的早期 诊断 和 基孔肯雅热 的精确 诊断 的强大潜力。新颖之处在于双模式平台集成了磁性探针和基于人工智能的定量建模,以提高检测灵敏度。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该平台可以为 基孔肯雅热 的早期 监测 策略和精确诊断提供信息,通过同时进行病原体和免疫标记检测,有可能改善 暴发 的反应和患者管理。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其依赖相对较小的临床样本量(n = 91),并且需要便携式仪器辅助才能达到最低检测限。证据强度中等,因为需要在更大、多样化的人群和现场环境中进行进一步验证以确认临床实用性。

papers.title: Spatial structure and demographic decoupling of chikungunya transmission and severity in Brazil, 2015 to 2025
papers.abstract: Abstract Brazil bears one of the largest chikungunya burdens in the Americas, and the 2024–25 wave expanded further south than any prior outbreak, yet evidence to guide vaccine rollout targeting is lacking. We analyzed 1,235,424 confirmed cases reported to SINAN (2015–2025) across 5,570 municipalities using a Bayesian hierarchical spatiotemporal model and age- and sex-stratified Cox models. Transmission epicenters shifted from the Northeast (2016–17) to the Central-West (2024–25) with persistent spatial clustering. Cases concentrated among adults aged 25–55, whereas post-hospitalization mortality rose steeply with age (hazard ratio 10·57, 95% CI 7·64–14·62 for ages ≥80 versus 20–29). Transmission intensity and case fatality were geographically decoupled. Because the populations contributing most reported cases are not those at highest risk of death, we derived a municipality-level allocation framework defining transmission-control, clinical-preparedness, and combined-priority zones, which is an actionable, updatable basis for targeting the ongoing pilot rollout.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the lack of evidence guiding vaccine rollout targeting for chikungunya virus, particularly as the 2024–25 outbreak expanded further south than any prior one in Brazil.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed 1,235,424 confirmed chikungunya cases reported to SINAN across 5,570 municipalities in Brazil from 2015 to 2025 using a Bayesian hierarchical spatiotemporal model and age- and sex-stratified Cox models.
analysis.methods: A Bayesian hierarchical spatiotemporal model and age- and sex-stratified Cox models were used to analyze confirmed chikungunya cases reported to SINAN across 5,570 municipalities in Brazil from 2015 to 2025.
analysis.main_results: Cases concentrated among adults aged 25–55, while post-hospitalization mortality increased steeply with age, with a hazard ratio of 10·57 (95% CI 7·64–14·62) for ages ≥80 compared to 20–29.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that transmission intensity and case fatality were geographically decoupled, highlighting a critical gap in understanding the relationship between transmission and severity.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide an actionable framework for targeting vaccine rollout in Brazil by identifying different priority zones based on transmission and clinical risk.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on reported cases, which may not fully capture the true burden, and the analysis is based on observational data without experimental controls. The evidence is moderate in strength.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the spatial structure and demographic decoupling of chikungunya transmission and severity in Brazil from 2015 to 2025. It highlights that while cases are concentrated among adults aged 25–55, mortality risk increases sharply with age, particularly in those over 80. The authors note that transmission intensity and case fatality are geographically decoupled, which has implications for vaccine targeting strategies. They propose a municipality-level allocation framework to guide the ongoing pilot vaccine rollout. The study uses a Bayesian hierarchical spatiotemporal model and age- and sex-stratified Cox models to analyze 1,235,424 confirmed cases reported to SINAN across 5,570 municipalities. The evidence is moderate in strength due to reliance on observational data and potential underreporting of cases.

papers.title: 3D-printed multi-electrode platform for electrochemical immunosensing of Chikungunya virus in serum samples.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (ChikV) detection requires accessible and reliable analytical tools, especially for decentralized testing. Herein, a 3D-printed multi-electrode platform was developed for the assembly of an electrochemical immunosensor for ChikV antigen determination. The system comprises a miniaturized electrochemical cell integrating six working electrodes modified with electrochemically reduced graphene oxide and functionalized with anti-ChikV antibodies, enabling simultaneous measurements and improved analytical reliability. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) provided sensitive detection over a linear range from 40 to 2600 pg mL-1, while square-wave voltammetry (SWV) extended the analytical response to higher concentrations (1.3-1300 ng mL-1), providing a broad dynamic range. The proposed immunosensor exhibited suitable selectivity against other arboviruses, including dengue and yellow fever viruses. Furthermore, the platform successfully discriminated between ChikV-positive and negative diluted serum samples, with statistically significant differences. The combination of additive manufacturing and electrochemical techniques provides a versatile, portable and customizable approach for ChikV screening, highlighting its potential for application in decentralized and resource-limited settings.

papers.title: Limited tissue persistence confirms attenuation of live-attenuated chikungunya vaccine VLA1553 in non-human primates
papers.abstract: Abstract Chronic chikungunya disease is caused by the mosquito-borne chikungunya virus (CHIKV) induced by viral persistence in target tissues. To investigate the risk of viral persistence of the approved live-attenuated vaccine IXCHIQ ® (VLA1553), cynomolgus macaques received a 100-fold higher dose than the approved dose for IXCHIQ ® or wild-type CHIKV. In VLA1553-treated NHPs, fever was transient, coinciding with peak viremia, with no significant virus detected in tissues except for immune organs. WT CHIKV-treated NHPs developed fever persisting for several days with higher peak viremias, and virus was consistently detected in tissues at higher levels than in VLA1553-treated animals. Additionally, WT CHIKV-treated NHPs showed more CHIKV in saliva and vaginal fluid, lymphocytopenia, increased liver enzymes and plasma prostaglandin E 2 , and higher expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines and chemokines associated with WT CHIKV disease than VLA1553-treated animals. This study demonstrated attenuation of vaccine strain VLA1553, with no critical observations in non-human primates (NHPs) following administration of a high dose.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the risk of viral persistence of the live-attenuated chikungunya vaccine VLA1553 in cynomolgus macaques. Animals received a 100-fold higher dose than the approved human dose or wild-type CHIKV. papers.title_zh: 有限的组织持久性证实了减毒活基孔肯雅病毒 疫苗 VLA1553 在非人类灵长类动物中的减毒作用
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Chronic chikungunya disease is caused by the mosquito-borne chikungunya virus (CHIKV) induced by viral persistence in target tissues. To investigate the risk of viral persistence of the approved live-attenuated vaccine IXCHIQ ® (VLA1553), cynomolgus macaques received a 100-fold higher dose than the approved dose for IXCHIQ ® or wild-type CHIKV. In VLA1553-treated NHPs, fever was transient, coinciding with peak viremia, with no significant virus detected in tissues except for immune organs. WT CHIKV-treated NHPs developed fever persisting for several days with higher peak viremias, and virus was consistently detected in tissues at higher levels than in VLA1553-treated animals. Additionally, WT CHIKV-treated NHPs showed more CHIKV in saliva and vaginal fluid, lymphocytopenia, increased liver enzymes and plasma prostaglandin E 2 , and higher expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines and chemokines associated with WT CHIKV disease than VLA1553-treated animals. This study demonstrated attenuation of vaccine strain VLA1553, with no critical observations in non-human primates (NHPs) following administration of a high dose.

papers.title: Autoantibodies neutralizing type I interferons underlie a third of cases of Chikungunya virus encephalitis or myelitis
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection is typically not life-threatening but may, in rare cases, affect the central nervous system (CNS). In three cohorts of confirmed CHIKV cases from Martinique (French overseas territory) and Brazil (patients aged 0--89 years, n = 245), 20 patients had CNS infection (aged 17--87 years). Autoantibodies neutralizing type I interferons (AAN-I-IFN) were found in 35% of patients (4 male and 3 female, aged 17--87 years) with encephalitis (4/15), encephalomyelitis (1/2), or myelitis (2/3), but were absent in 225 patients without CNS infection. They neutralized high concentrations (10--1,000 ng/mL) of IFN-2, IFN-8, and IFN-{omega}, and the antibodies of one patient also neutralized IFN-{beta}. All samples also neutralized the other 10 IFN- subtypes (at least 100 pg/mL). This combination of blood autoantibodies occurs in ~0.02% and 0.6% of healthy individuals under and over 70 years of age, respectively. The presence of AAN-I-IFN before CHIKV infection therefore increased the risk of CNS disease ~850-fold relative to the general population.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the role of autoantibodies neutralizing type I interferons (AAN-I-IFN) in Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection, particularly in cases involving the central nervous system (CNS). Among 245 confirmed CHIKV cases from Martinique and Brazil, 20 patients had CNS infection, and 35% of these patients (7 out of 20) tested positive for AAN-I-IFN, compared to none in the non-CNS group. The presence of AAN-I-IFN was associated with an approximately 850-fold increased risk of CNS disease relative to the general population. The autoantibodies neutralized high concentrations of multiple interferon subtypes, and their prevalence in healthy individuals was low (0.02% under 70 years and 0.6% over 70 years). These findings highlight a significant risk factor for severe CHIKV-related neurological complications, potentially guiding targeted interventions.

papers.title: Characterization of an immunocompetent, young adult mouse model for studying chikungunya virus neuroinvasion and central nervous system infection.
papers.abstract: The arthropod-borne chikungunya virus poses a re-emerging global health threat, causing millions of cases worldwide. Neurological complications induced by chikungunya virus are being increasingly reported in vulnerable populations, including infants and young children. However, the mechanisms by which chikungunya virus invades the central nervous system and drives prolonged neurological dysfunction remain poorly defined. Studying neurological chikungunya virus infection has been limited by the lack of an immunocompetent, neurodevelopmentally appropriate small-animal model that reliably develops central nervous system infection and neurological disease by infection routes analogous to natural transmission. Following a screen of ten Collaborative Cross mouse strains, we identified four-to-six-week-old CC041 mice as an immunocompetent, neurodevelopmentally appropriate model that consistently exhibits chikungunya virus neuroinvasion and clinical signs consistent with neurological disease following peripheral inoculation. Central nervous system infection in CC041 mice was dependent on the chikungunya viral strain used, despite comparable viral replication at the inoculation site, and occurred at physiologically relevant inoculation doses without enhancement at higher doses. Comparative analyses with neuroinvasion-resistant C57BL/6J mice demonstrated that susceptibility to neuroinvasion in CC041 mice was associated with enhanced dissemination beyond the site of inoculation, prolonged serum viral load, and lower peripheral type I interferon levels early in infection. In vivo imaging using a reporter chikungunya virus confirmed rapid viral spread and early brain localization in CC041 mice, in contrast to the restricted peripheral infection observed in C57BL/6J mice. Examination of viral antigen expression by immunohistochemistry revealed regionally variable viral localization in the brain, with central nervous system infection occurring independently of virus-induced blood-brain barrier disruption or experimental macrophage depletion. Furthermore, CC041 mice developed clinical signs consistent with neurological disease that persisted beyond the period when infectious virus was detected in the brain. Together, these findings establish CC041 mice as a tractable, immunocompetent model for studying chikungunya virus-associated neurological disease following peripheral infection.

papers.abstract_zh: 节肢动物传播的 基孔肯雅病毒 对全球健康构成了重新出现的威胁,在全球造成了数百万例病例。基孔肯雅病毒 引起的神经系统并发症在包括婴儿和幼儿在内的弱势群体中越来越多地报道。然而,基孔肯雅病毒 侵入中枢神经系统并导致长期神经功能障碍的机制仍不清楚。研究神经系统 基孔肯雅病毒 感染受到了限制,因为缺乏免疫活性强、神经发育适宜的小动物模型,该模型能够通过类似于天然 传播 的感染途径可靠地发展中枢神经系统感染和神经系统疾病。在筛选了 10 只 Collaborative Cross 小鼠品系后,我们将 4 至 6 周龄的 CC041 小鼠确定为具有免疫活性、神经发育合适的模型,其始终表现出 基孔肯雅病毒 神经侵袭和与外周接种后神经系统疾病一致的临床体征。CC041小鼠的中枢神经系统感染取决于所使用的基孔肯雅病毒株,尽管在接种部位的病毒复制相当,并且在生理相关的接种剂量下发生,而在更高剂量下没有增强。与神经侵袭抗性 C57BL/6J 小鼠的比较分析表明,CC041 小鼠对神经侵袭的易感性与接种部位以外的传播增强、血清病毒载量延长以及感染早期外周 I 型干扰素水平较低有关。使用记者 基孔肯雅病毒 进行的体内成像证实了 CC041 小鼠中病毒的快速传播和早期大脑定位,与 C57BL/6J 小鼠中观察到的有限外周感染形成鲜明对比。通过免疫组织化学检查病毒抗原表达,发现病毒在大脑中的定位存在区域差异,中枢神经系统感染的发生与病毒引起的血脑屏障破坏或实验性巨噬细胞耗竭无关。此外,CC041小鼠出现了与神经系统疾病一致的临床症状,这些症状在大脑中检测到传染性病毒之后仍然持续存在。总之,这些发现将 CC041 小鼠确立为一种易于处理、具有免疫活性的模型,用于研究外周感染后 基孔肯雅病毒 相关的神经系统疾病。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及筛选 10 种 Collaborative Cross 小鼠品系,并鉴定 4 至 6 周龄的 CC041 小鼠作为免疫活性强、神经发育合适的模型,该模型始终表现出 基孔肯雅病毒 神经侵袭和与外周接种后神经系统疾病一致的临床体征。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用报告基因 基孔肯雅病毒 进行体内成像,以确认病毒传播和大脑定位,并通过免疫组织化学检查病毒抗原表达,以评估大脑中的区域病毒定位。
analysis_zh.main_results: CC041小鼠出现了与神经系统疾病一致的临床症状,这种疾病持续超过了在大脑中检测到感染性病毒的时期,并且中枢神经系统感染依赖于所使用的基孔肯雅病毒株,尽管在接种部位的病毒复制相当。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,这些发现将 CC041 小鼠建立为一种易处理、具有免疫功能的模型,用于研究外周感染后与 基孔肯雅病毒 相关的神经系统疾病,这是对该领域的一项新贡献。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该模型可以为未来关于 基孔肯雅病毒 神经侵袭机制、神经系统疾病 发病机制 以及弱势群体神经系统并发症的潜在治疗干预措施的研究提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 尽管研究结果仅限于特定的小鼠品系和病毒株,但证据强度很高,因为该研究提供了模型的详细特征,包括与耐药菌株的比较分析和多种验证方法。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to report serious adverse events (AEs) associated with the chikungunya vaccine Ixchiq, highlighting the need for pharmacovigilance monitoring of this newly approved vaccine.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The report is based on pharmacovigilance data from Lareb (Netherlands Pharmacovigilance Centre), documenting serious side effects of the chikungunya vaccine Ixchiq.
analysis.methods: The study involved collecting and analyzing pharmacovigilance reports on serious AEs linked to the chikungunya vaccine Ixchiq, though specific analytical methods are not detailed in the provided evidence.
analysis.main_results: Serious adverse events related to the chikungunya vaccine Ixchiq were reported, though specific numerical data or detailed outcomes are not provided in the evidence.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the reported serious AEs as a signal requiring ongoing surveillance, emphasizing the novelty of monitoring a recently approved chikungunya vaccine.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform post-marketing surveillance efforts for the chikungunya vaccine, aiding in the assessment of its safety profile and public health risk management.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to pharmacovigilance reports without detailed case analysis or control groups, resulting in low confidence due to the absence of systematic data and potential underreporting.

analysis.summary_en: This report documents serious adverse events (AEs) associated with the chikungunya vaccine Ixchiq, based on pharmacovigilance data from Lareb (Netherlands Pharmacovigilance Centre). The study highlights the need for ongoing surveillance of this newly approved vaccine to monitor its safety profile. While the report signals potential serious AEs, it lacks detailed numerical data or systematic analysis, limiting the strength of the evidence. The findings underscore the importance of post-marketing pharmacovigilance to ensure the safe use of the chikungunya vaccine in public health settings.

papers.title: Análise espaço-temporal da expansão e persistência da chikungunya no Nordeste do Brasil (2015–2023)
papers.abstract: RESUMO Objetivos: Analisar a dinâmica espaço-temporal da incidência de chikungunya nos municípios da região Nordeste do Brasil, de 2015 a 2023. Métodos: Estudo ecológico de série temporal com casos prováveis de chikungunya notificados no Sistema de Informação de Agravos de Notificação (SINAN). A tendência temporal mensal foi analisada pela regressão por pontos de inflexão ( joinpoint ), cálculo do Percentual de Variação Mensal (PVM) e intervalos de Confiança de 95% (IC95%). Identificaram-se aglomerados espaço-temporais de alto risco pela varredura Scan de Poisson (risco relativo - RR, valor p Resultados: Foram notificados 769.986 casos (2015-2023), concentrados nos estados do Ceará (27,9%), Bahia (25,3%) e Pernambuco (14,5%). Epidemias explosivas ocorreram em 2016, 2017 e 2022, intercaladas por períodos de baixa transmissão. A análise temporal revelou PVMs iniciais elevados, como no Maranhão (127,4%; IC95%: 112,5–172,6). Em 2022, epidemias explosivas voltaram a ocorrer, com destaque para Alagoas (PVM = 342,4%; IC95%: 187,2–557,3) e Piauí (PVM = 242,9%; IC95%: 162,6–441,8). Foram identificados aglomerados espaço-temporais significativos, 70% deles com início em 2016. Observou-se dissociação entre extensão geográfica e intensidade do risco: o maior RR (45,5; IC95%: 43,7–47,3) ocorreu em um cluster na Bahia, em 2020, e o de maior abrangência envolveu 431 municípios de quatro estados, em 2016. Conclusão: A dinâmica da chikungunya no Nordeste caracterizou-se por heterogeneidade espaço-temporal, com deslocamento de epicentros e persistência de bolsões de alto risco, reforçando a necessidade de vigilância e controle integrados e regionalizados, visando responder à transmissão sustentada em bolsões de alto risco e aos clusters interestaduais.
authors: Amanda Priscila de Santana Cabral Silva

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to analyze the spatial-temporal dynamics of chikungunya incidence in municipalities across the Northeast region of Brazil from 2015 to 2023, addressing the need to understand the disease's spread and persistence.
analysis.study_design_and_population: An ecological time-series study was conducted using probable chikungunya cases reported in the SINAN system, covering the Northeast region of Brazil from 2015 to 2023, with a total of 769,986 cases identified.
analysis.methods: Temporal trends were analyzed using joinpoint regression, monthly percentage variation (PVM), and 95% confidence intervals (IC95%). Spatial clusters were identified through Poisson scan analysis.
analysis.main_results: A total of 769,986 cases were reported, with the highest concentrations in Ceará (27.9%), Bahia (25.3%), and Pernambuco (14.5%). Explosive epidemics occurred in 2016, 2017, and 2022, alternating with periods of low transmission. In 2022, Alagoas and Piauí had notable PVMs of 342.4% and 242.9%, respectively.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the spatial-temporal heterogeneity of chikungunya outbreaks, with shifting epicenters and persistent high-risk clusters, emphasizing the need for region-specific surveillance and control strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study provides critical insights for targeted surveillance and control measures in high-risk areas, aiding in the development of regionalized public health responses to chikungunya transmission.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on reported cases and does not include direct virological or clinical data, which may limit the depth of understanding. The evidence is moderate in strength due to reliance on ecological data.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed the spatial-temporal dynamics of chikungunya incidence in the Northeast region of Brazil from 2015 to 2023. It identified explosive epidemics in 2016, 2017, and 2022, with high concentrations of cases in Ceará, Bahia, and Pernambuco. The research revealed significant spatial clusters, with the largest in 2016 involving 431 municipalities across four states. The findings underscore the need for region-specific surveillance and control strategies to address persistent high-risk areas and clusters. The study's reliance on ecological data limits its depth, but it provides valuable insights for public health planning.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在分析 2015 年至 2023 年巴西东北地区各城市基孔肯雅热 发病率 的时空动态,以满足了解该疾病的传播和持续性的需要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 利用SINAN系统报告的基孔肯雅热疑似病例进行了生态时间序列研究,覆盖2015年至2023年巴西东北部地区,共发现769,986例病例。
elements_zh.methods: 使用连接点回归、每月百分比变化 (PVM) 和 95% 置信区间 (IC95%) 分析时间趋势。通过泊松扫描分析识别空间集群。
elements_zh.main_results: 总共报告了 769,986 例病例,其中塞阿拉州 (27.9%)、巴伊亚州 (25.3%) 和伯南布哥州 (14.5%) 的病例集中度最高。爆发性流行病发生在 2016 年、2017 年和 2022 年,与低 传播 时期交替出现。2022 年,阿拉戈斯州和皮奥伊州的 PVM 分别为 342.4% 和 242.9%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调了基孔肯雅热 暴发 的时空异质性,其震中不断变化,高风险群持续存在,强调需要针对特定​​区域的 暴发 和控制策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究为高风险地区的针对性 监测 和控制措施提供了重要见解,有助于制定针对基孔肯雅热 传播 的区域化公共卫生应对措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于报告的病例,不包括直接的病毒学或临床数据,这可能会限制理解的深度。由于依赖生态数据,证据强度中等。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the need to integrate urban environments into One Health approaches for chikungunya, highlighting the global emergence of arthropod-borne viral diseases and the role of urban ecosystems in disease transmission.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This is a conceptual review paper that synthesizes evidence on urban environments and chikungunya, drawing on existing literature to inform One Health strategies without involving primary data collection or specific populations.
analysis.methods: The authors conducted a narrative review of existing literature, focusing on the intersection of urban ecology, mosquito-borne diseases, and One Health frameworks, without employing original data generation or statistical analyses.
analysis.main_results: The review identifies key urban drivers of Aedes mosquito proliferation, such as artificial light at night and aquatic habitat availability, and evaluates evidence-based interventions like house screening for mosquito control.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret urban environments as critical yet underutilized components of One Health approaches for chikungunya, emphasizing the novelty of integrating urban science into disease control strategies.

papers.title: Productive Mayaro Virus Infection Requires Host Fatty Acid Synthase for nsP1 S-palmitoylation
papers.abstract: To date, twenty-seven pathogenic human viruses require host-catalyzed de novo fatty acid biosynthesis for replication. This pathway is driven by fatty acid synthase (FASN), which produces palmitate. Palmitate is a precursor for various functions during viral infection, including lipid droplet formation for assembly, beta-oxidation for ATP generation, and post-translational modification of proteins. Whether Mayaro virus (MAYV), an emerging alphavirus that causes debilitating arthritogenic disease, required FASN for infection was unknown. Using genetic and pharmacological approaches in a human cell line and primary cell model, we found that MAYV requires FASN-dependent palmitate synthesis for virion production. To determine how palmitate contributes to infection, we pharmacologically inhibited pathways downstream of FASN and found that only 2-bromopalmitate (2-BP), a protein palmitoylation inhibitor, led to a 94% reduction in MAYV infection. S-palmitoylation is a post-translational modification in which palmitate is attached to sulfur atoms in cysteine residues. In chikungunya virus, a related alphavirus, FASN-dependent palmitoylation of nonstructural protein 1 (nsP1) is essential for membrane association and replication. Consequently, we hypothesized that MAYV nsP1 is palmitoylated in a FASN-dependent manner. Using an alkyne acetate analog, Alk-4, metabolized by FASN into alkyne palmitate, we observed specific labeling of wild-type nsP1 at conserved cysteine residues (C417-419), but not of a cysteine-to-alanine triple mutant. Treatment with TVB-2640 or 2-BP abrogated Alk-4 labeling of wild-type nsP1 during active infection, reinforcing that MAYV protein palmitoylation is a FASN-dependent process. Our findings reveal a conserved mechanism of FASN-dependent protein palmitoylation in alphaviruses and highlight FASN as a potential anti-viral target.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to determine whether Mayaro virus (MAYV), an emerging alphavirus causing debilitating arthritogenic disease, requires host fatty acid synthase (FASN) for infection, as this pathway is known to be essential for replication in twenty-seven other pathogenic human viruses.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research used genetic and pharmacological approaches in a human cell line and primary cell model to investigate MAYV's dependence on FASN and its role in viral infection.
analysis.methods: The study employed an alkyne acetate analog (Alk-4) metabolized by FASN into alkyne palmitate to label wild-type nsP1 at conserved cysteine residues, and pharmacologically inhibited pathways downstream of FASN, including 2-bromopalmitate (2-BP), to assess their impact on MAYV infection.
analysis.main_results: The findings revealed that MAYV requires FASN-dependent palmitate synthesis for virion production, and inhibition of protein palmitoylation with 2-BP led to a 94% reduction in MAYV infection, with specific labeling of wild-type nsP1 at conserved cysteine residues (C417-419) observed.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these results as indicating a conserved mechanism of FASN-dependent protein palmitoylation in alphaviruses, highlighting FASN as a potential anti-viral target, and demonstrated that MAYV nsP1 is palmitoylated in a FASN-dependent manner.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that targeting FASN-dependent palmitoylation could be a viable strategy for developing antiviral therapies against MAYV and potentially other alphaviruses, contributing to the understanding of viral replication mechanisms and potential treatment options.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was conducted in vitro using human cell lines and primary cells, which may not fully recapitulate in vivo conditions; however, the use of both genetic and pharmacological approaches provides strong evidence for the role of FASN in MAYV infection, warranting a high confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated whether Mayaro virus (MAYV), an emerging alphavirus, requires host fatty acid synthase (FASN) for infection. Using genetic and pharmacological approaches in human cell lines and primary cells, the researchers found that MAYV depends on FASN-mediated palmitate synthesis for virion production. Inhibition of protein palmitoylation with 2-bromopalmitate reduced infection by 94%, and specific labeling of nsP1 at conserved cysteine residues confirmed FASN-dependent palmitoylation. The findings reveal a conserved mechanism in alphaviruses and suggest FASN as a potential antiviral target, offering insights into viral replication and therapeutic strategies.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在确定 Mayaro 病毒 (MAYV)(一种引起衰弱性关节炎疾病的新兴甲病毒)是否需要 宿主 脂肪酸合酶 (FASN) 进行感染,因为已知该途径对于 27 种其他致病性人类病毒的复制至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在人类细胞系和原代细胞模型中使用遗传和药理学方法来研究 MAYV 对 FASN 的依赖性及其在病毒感染中的作用。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用了由 FASN 代谢为炔烃棕榈酸酯的炔乙酸类似物 (Alk-4),在保守的半胱氨酸残基处标记野生型 nsP1,并通过药理学抑制 FASN 下游的通路,包括 2-溴棕榈酸酯 (2-BP),以评估其对 MAYV 感染的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究结果表明,MAYV 需要 FASN 依赖性棕榈酸酯合成来产生病毒颗粒,用 2-BP 抑制蛋白质棕榈酰化可导致 MAYV 感染减少 94%,并观察到野生型 nsP1 在保守的半胱氨酸残基 (C417-419) 处进行特异性标记。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些结果解释为表明甲病毒中 FASN 依赖性蛋白棕榈酰化的保守机制,强调 FASN 作为潜在的抗病毒靶点,并证明 MAYV nsP1 以 FASN 依赖性方式棕榈酰化。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,针对 FASN 依赖性棕榈酰化可能是开发针对 MAYV 和潜在其他甲病毒的 抗病毒药物 疗法的可行策略,有助于了解病毒复制机制和潜在的 治疗 选择。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是使用人类细胞系和原代细胞在体外进行的,可能无法完全重现体内条件;然而,遗传和药理学方法的使用为 FASN 在 MAYV 感染中的作用提供了强有力的证据,值得进行高置信度评估。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to determine whether Mayaro virus (MAYV), an emerging alphavirus causing debilitating arthritogenic disease, requires host fatty acid synthase (FASN) for infection, as this pathway is known to be essential for replication in twenty-seven other pathogenic human viruses.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The research used genetic and pharmacological approaches in a human cell line and primary cell model to investigate MAYV's dependence on FASN and its role in viral infection.
analysis_en.methods: The study employed an alkyne acetate analog (Alk-4) metabolized by FASN into alkyne palmitate to label wild-type nsP1 at conserved cysteine residues, and pharmacologically inhibited pathways downstream of FASN, including 2-bromopalmitate (2-BP), to assess their impact on MAYV infection.
analysis_en.main_results: The findings revealed that MAYV requires FASN-dependent palmitate synthesis for virion production, and inhibition of protein palmitoylation with 2-BP led to a 94% reduction in MAYV infection, with specific labeling of wild-type nsP1 at conserved cysteine residues (C417-419) observed.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these results as indicating a conserved mechanism of FASN-dependent protein palmitoylation in alphaviruses, highlighting FASN as a potential anti-viral target, and demonstrated that MAYV nsP1 is palmitoylated in a FASN-dependent manner.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that targeting FASN-dependent palmitoylation could be a viable strategy for developing antiviral therapies against MAYV and potentially other alphaviruses, contributing to the understanding of viral replication mechanisms and potential treatment options.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was conducted in vitro using human cell lines and primary cells, which may not fully recapitulate in vivo conditions; however, the use of both genetic and pharmacological approaches provides strong evidence for the role of FASN in MAYV infection, warranting a high confidence assessment.

papers.title_zh: 生产性 Mayaro 病毒感染需要 宿主 脂肪酸合酶进行 nsP1 S-棕榈酰化
papers.source_body_en: To date, twenty-seven pathogenic human viruses require host-catalyzed de novo fatty acid biosynthesis for replication. This pathway is driven by fatty acid synthase (FASN), which produces palmitate. Palmitate is a precursor for various functions during viral infection, including lipid droplet formation for assembly, beta-oxidation for ATP generation, and post-translational modification of proteins. Whether Mayaro virus (MAYV), an emerging alphavirus that causes debilitating arthritogenic disease, required FASN for infection was unknown. Using genetic and pharmacological approaches in a human cell line and primary cell model, we found that MAYV requires FASN-dependent palmitate synthesis for virion production. To determine how palmitate contributes to infection, we pharmacologically inhibited pathways downstream of FASN and found that only 2-bromopalmitate (2-BP), a protein palmitoylation inhibitor, led to a 94% reduction in MAYV infection. S-palmitoylation is a post-translational modification in which palmitate is attached to sulfur atoms in cysteine residues. In chikungunya virus, a related alphavirus, FASN-dependent palmitoylation of nonstructural protein 1 (nsP1) is essential for membrane association and replication. Consequently, we hypothesized that MAYV nsP1 is palmitoylated in a FASN-dependent manner. Using an alkyne acetate analog, Alk-4, metabolized by FASN into alkyne palmitate, we observed specific labeling of wild-type nsP1 at conserved cysteine residues (C417-419), but not of a cysteine-to-alanine triple mutant. Treatment with TVB-2640 or 2-BP abrogated Alk-4 labeling of wild-type nsP1 during active infection, reinforcing that MAYV protein palmitoylation is a FASN-dependent process. Our findings reveal a conserved mechanism of FASN-dependent protein palmitoylation in alphaviruses and highlight FASN as a potential anti-viral target.
papers.abstract_zh: 迄今为止,27 种人类致病病毒需要 宿主 催化的脂肪酸从头生物合成才能复制。该途径由产生棕榈酸的脂肪酸合酶 (FASN) 驱动。棕榈酸酯是病毒感染期间多种功能的前体,包括用于组装的脂滴形成、用于生成 ATP 的 β 氧化以及蛋白质的翻译后修饰。马亚罗病毒(MAYV)是一种新兴的甲病毒,会导致衰弱性关节炎疾病,是否需要 FASN 来感染尚不清楚。在人类细胞系和原代细胞模型中使用遗传和药理学方法,我们发现 MAYV 需要 FASN 依赖性棕榈酸酯合成来产生病毒粒子。为了确定棕榈酸酯如何导致感染,我们通过药理学抑制 FASN 下游途径,发现只有 2-溴棕榈酸酯 (2-BP)(一种蛋白质棕榈酰化抑制剂)才能使 MAYV 感染减少 94%。S-棕榈酰化是一种翻译后修饰,其中棕榈酸酯连接到半胱氨酸残基中的硫原子上。在 基孔肯雅病毒(一种相关的甲病毒)中,非结构蛋白 1 (nsP1) 的 FASN 依赖性棕榈酰化对于膜关联和复制至关重要。因此,我们假设 MAYV nsP1 以 FASN 依赖性方式被棕榈酰化。使用由 FASN 代谢为炔烃棕榈酸酯的炔乙酸类似物 Alk-4,我们观察到野生型 nsP1 在保守的半胱氨酸残基 (C417-419) 处有特异性标记,但没有观察到半胱氨酸至丙氨酸三重突变体的特异性标记。治疗 与 TVB-2640 或 2-BP 一起消除了活性感染期间野生型 nsP1 的 Alk-4 标记,强化了 MAYV 蛋白棕榈酰化是 FASN 依赖性过程。我们的研究结果揭示了甲病毒中 FASN 依赖性蛋白棕榈酰化的保守机制,并强调 FASN 作为潜在的抗病毒靶点。

papers.title: Vector competence across Aedes aegypti populations shaped by host-preference adaptation and host-pathogen interactions.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Aedes aegypti is the principal vector for yellow fever, dengue, Zika, and chikungunya viruses. Although this mosquito continues to expand its global range, its intrinsic ability to acquire, support the replication of, and transmit specific viruses—known as vector competence (VC)—varies across populations. A mechanistic understanding of this variation is a key goal of vector biology and is central to devising interventions to contain epidemics. In this review, we examine how evolutionary history fundamentally shaped VC in the sylvatic and human-adapted subspecies of Ae. We discuss how the physiological processes underlying arbovirus infection define transmission potential and synthesize our understanding of the global heterogeneity in VC for the principal arboviruses transmitted by Ae. Finally, we evaluate emerging insights into the molecular mechanisms that may drive this variation, with emphasis on the mosquito virome and the antiviral RNA interference pathways, and how these, in turn, help shape the genetic architecture associated with the intrinsic capacity to transmit arboviruses.

elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 人们一致认为,进化史从根本上塑造了伊蚊的森林亚种和人类适应亚种的 VC。埃及伊蚊,虫媒病毒感染的生理过程定义了 传播 的潜力,VC 的整体异质性是一个稳定的发现。

analysis_en.scope_and_question: The review focuses on Aedes aegypti as the principal vector for chikungunya virus and examines how evolutionary history shapes vector competence (VC) across its subspecies, with the central question being the mechanistic understanding of VC variation to inform epidemic interventions.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review synthesizes global heterogeneity in VC for arboviruses transmitted by Ae. aegypti, examining physiological processes and molecular mechanisms, including the mosquito virome and antiviral RNA interference pathways, but does not specify databases, search dates, or study counts.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: There is agreement that evolutionary history fundamentally shapes VC in sylvatic and human-adapted subspecies of Ae. aegypti, and that physiological processes underlying arbovirus infection define transmission potential, with global heterogeneity in VC being a stable finding.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights emerging insights into molecular mechanisms driving VC variation but does not explicitly address conflicting findings, weak methods, or missing populations/regions, though it acknowledges gaps in understanding the genetic architecture associated with intrinsic transmission capacity.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: Priorities include evaluating molecular mechanisms (e.g., mosquito virome and RNA interference pathways) that shape VC variation, with implications for devising interventions to contain epidemics, but no specific research or policy recommendations are provided.

papers.title_zh: 宿主 埃及伊蚊种群的 宿主 能力由 宿主 偏好适应和 宿主 病原体相互作用决定。
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Aedes aegypti is the principal vector for yellow fever, dengue, Zika, and chikungunya viruses. Although this mosquito continues to expand its global range, its intrinsic ability to acquire, support the replication of, and transmit specific viruses—known as vector competence (VC)—varies across populations. A mechanistic understanding of this variation is a key goal of vector biology and is central to devising interventions to contain epidemics. In this review, we examine how evolutionary history fundamentally shaped VC in the sylvatic and human-adapted subspecies of Ae. We discuss how the physiological processes underlying arbovirus infection define transmission potential and synthesize our understanding of the global heterogeneity in VC for the principal arboviruses transmitted by Ae. Finally, we evaluate emerging insights into the molecular mechanisms that may drive this variation, with emphasis on the mosquito virome and the antiviral RNA interference pathways, and how these, in turn, help shape the genetic architecture associated with the intrinsic capacity to transmit arboviruses.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 埃及伊蚊是黄热病、登革热、寨卡病毒和 基孔肯雅病毒 的主要 媒介。尽管这种蚊子不断扩大其全球范围,但其获取、支持复制和传播特定病毒的内在能力(称为 媒介 能力 (VC))因种群而异。对这种变异的机械理解是 媒介 生物学的一个关键目标,对于制定遏制流行病的干预措施至关重要。在这篇综述中,我们研究了进化史如何从根本上塑造了伊蚊的森林亚种和适应人类的亚种中的 VC。我们讨论虫媒病毒感染的生理过程如何定义 传播 潜力,并综合我们对伊蚊传播的主要虫媒病毒 VC 整体异质性的理解。最后,我们评估了对可能驱动这种变异的分子机制的新见解,重点是蚊子病毒组和 抗病毒药物 RNA 干扰途径,以及它们如何反过来帮助塑造与传播虫媒病毒的内在能力相关的遗传结构。

papers.title: Trifluoperazine exhibits broad-spectrum antiviral activity against arboviruses.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The recurrent outbreaks and geographical expansion of mosquito-borne arboviruses pose a significant challenge to public health worldwide. The disease outcome for arboviral infections ranges from acute febrile illness to severe conditions such as encephalitis, hemorrhagic shock, and mortality. Current treatment options for these viruses are limited to supportive care, necessitating an urgent need for a safe and effective broad-spectrum antiviral. In this study, we have identified trifluoperazine (TFP), an FDA-approved antipsychotic, as a potent broad-spectrum antiviral against Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV), Dengue virus (DENV), and Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infections. The antiviral effect of TFP was also seen in the animal models of JEV and CHIKV with significantly reduced disease severity. Mechanistically, TFP treatment increased the phosphorylation of eIF2a and induced an adaptive ER stress response in diverse cell types. Alleviation of TFP-induced ER stress by chemical chaperone 4PBA abolished the antiviral activity of the drug and rescued virus replication in cells and CHIKV mice model. The robust in vitro and in vivo efficacy of the drug against arboviruses highlights the potential for repurposing TFP as a broad-spectrum antiviral candidate and underscores the importance of ER stress as a therapeutic target.
